title: End-of-Sale & End-of-Life Notice for Zscaler Cloud Security Posture Management

blocks.text: Zscaler is announcing the End-of-Sale (EOS) and End-of-Life (EOL) dates for Zscaler Cloud Security Posture Management (ZCSPM).
As of October 18, 2022, licenses for new ZCSPM subscriptions will not be available for purchase. The ZCSPM service and all existing tenants will continue to be supported until the EOL date.

If you are using ZCSPM, you should consider a migration plan to Zscaler Posture Control (ZPC)—the new generation platform, covering ZCSPM functionality and multiple additional modules and features. The ZPC service is now available for ZCSPM customers with no extra charge for the remainder of the subscription period.
Contact Zscaler Support to devise a migration plan.
To learn more about ZPC, see https://www.zscaler.com/products/posture-control. If you have additional questions, contact Zscaler Support.
